title: A Sister's Determination
next_chapter_hook: In the instant when Chen Nian's bloodline power surged within her body, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly emitted a humming sound—two yellowed pages simultaneously revealed the same blurry vision, in which a figure with an indistinguishable face stood beneath the collapsing celestial dome.

text.content: The air within the Council Hall seemed to freeze into icy寒冰. Han Lie's questioning gaze swept across everyone present, finally landing on Chen Ji, his eyes burning with suppressed fury. "Chen Ji, you have quite the audacity, daring to act at such a time—" Before he could finish, a gentle yet resolute voice rang out from beside Chen Ji. "Brother Han, if there's something to discuss, why not sit down first." Chen Nian had risen to her feet at some point, those clear eyes calmly fixed on Han Lie, showing none of her usual timidity.

dialogue.content: "Little Nian, you—" Chen Ji下意识想要阻止，却被陈念轻轻抬手制止。那只手白皙纤细，却在挥动的瞬间带起一缕若有若无的灵光。陈机瞳孔骤然收缩，那缕灵光中蕴含的波动，分明是筑基后期的气息！不，甚至已经触及到了金丹的边缘。这怎么可能？他的妹妹，那个被所有人都认定为无法修炼的废物，何时——

text.content: Han Lie clearly sensed the anomaly as well, his brow furrowed deeply as he coldly remarked: "Chen Nian? A servant disciple like you dares to speak here?" Yet Chen Nian showed no anger; instead, she smiled faintly, that smile carrying a composure that sent chills through one's heart. "Brother Han, whether I deserve to speak here is perhaps not for you to decide." She slowly walked to the center of the Council Hall, spiritual energy beginning to flow gently around her. Only then did those present realize with shock that this usually silent young girl carried such astonishing power within her.

dialogue.content: "Brother, I know you've always wanted to protect me." Chen Nian's voice suddenly softened, she turned around, her gaze falling on Chen Ji's face, her eyes slightly reddened. "But have you ever thought, that I, sheltered behind you, have always wanted to stand by your side?" Her voice trembled, yet carried unwavering determination. "When the Holy Sect's people took me away that day, what did Father say while holding your hand? Do you remember?" This sentence struck Chen Ji's heart like a heavy hammer—the scene of their father's final moments surged forth like a tide—that pair of clouded eyes full of hope, the testament words he had deliberately forgotten.

text.content: The Council Hall fell into dead silence. Everyone's gaze concentrated on Chen Nian, awaiting the continuation. Chen Ji took a deep breath, his voice hoarse: "Father said... to protect you well, to keep you far from all this." Chen Nian shook her head, tears finally streaming down her face. "Wrong." Her voice carried a sob, yet was crystal clear. "What Father said was—'The Chen family's bloodline should not have only one person fighting.' Brother, you've always misunderstood." Chen Ji's body shuddered violently; that testament he had deeply buried in his memories now exploded in his mind like thunder.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, the image of his father's dying moments emerging in his mind. Those withered hands tightly gripping his, those clouded eyes filled with reluctance and hope. "Ji'er... the Chen family's fate... should not be borne by you alone... Little Nian... her bloodline... is more powerful than you imagine..." Before he could finish, the old man passed away. At that time, Chen Ji thought his father was delirious, deeply burying this testament in his heart, unaware it had become the deepest barrier between him and his sister. "Little Nian..." He opened his eyes, voice slightly trembling. "All these years, you've been hiding?"

"Not hiding, waiting." Chen Nian raised her hand to wipe away the tears at the corner of her eyes, her lips curving into a bitter smile. "Brother, do you know how I spent those years at the Holy Sect?" Her voice turned low. "They treated me as a vessel, as a tool, using my bloodline to unlock those damnable forbidden arts. Every act of resistance brought only more cruel tortures." Here, she raised her head, her gaze burning with the flames of revenge. "But it was those years that awakened the dormant power within me. The Chen family's bloodline was never trash—it simply needed a specific契机 to awaken."

text.content: Chen Ji tightly clenched his fists, his knuckles white from exertion. He thought of his arrangements over these years, of those blurry prophecies in the Tianji Record—every vision featuring Chen Nian had been chaos. So it wasn't the Tianji Record that had problems, but his sister's existence itself interfered with the direction of fate. "So you've been waiting this whole time?" His voice was barely audible. "Waiting for me to grow stronger? Waiting for me to have the ability to protect you?" Chen Nian shook her head, walked up to him, and took his fists in her hands. "No, I was waiting for an opportunity to fight shoulder to shoulder with you."

In the instant their hands touched, a strange power suddenly surged from within Chen Nian. It was a strand of pale golden light, resonating across the distance with the faint glow emanating from the Tianji Record Fragment on Chen Ji's chest. "This is—" Chen Ji's pupils dilated in shock; the fragment at his chest flew out uncontrollably, attracted by another fragment emerging from Chen Nian's palm. The two fragments slowly approached each other in the air, emanating an ancient and mysterious aura. "Brother, so you've always had this too." Chen Nian's voice carried a sense of sudden realization. "I thought my copy was accidentally obtained, so it turns out... from the very beginning, we were the two chosen ones."

dialogue.content: "Enough!" Han Lie suddenly roared, breaking the eerie atmosphere. His face was ashen, spiritual energy churning around him, clearly pushed beyond rage by everything before him. "I don't care what Chen family bloodline or Tianji Record you have—during this trip to the secret realm, neither of you will—" However, before he could finish, Chen Nian abruptly turned around, those golden-bright eyes fixed straight on Han Lie, an invisible pressure suddenly descending. Han Lie's form wavered, involuntarily stepping back half a pace. "Brother Han," Chen Nian's voice was calm as still water, yet carried undeniable power, "I respect you as a genius of Xuanwu Sect, but genius doesn't give you the right to interfere in Chen family affairs."

text.content: Han Lie's complexion flushed red, a flash of fear in his eyes. He could clearly sense that the power within this young girl was丝毫不弱于自己，隐隐有压制之势。"This is impossible... how could you have such strength..." His voice began to tremble, that优越感在这一刻荡然无存。议事厅内的其他弟子更是噤若寒蝉，看向陈念的目光中满是敬畏与震撼。这个平日里被他们嘲笑的废物少女，此刻竟展现出足以比肩宗门首席的实力。

dialogue.content: Chen Ji静静地看着这一幕，心中五味杂陈。他想起自己这些年来以废物人设行走江湖，暗中算无遗策，却从未想过，自己的妹妹也在暗中积攒力量，等待着有朝一日能与他并肩。他深吸一口气，缓缓走上前，将两页天机录残页同时握住。温热的触感从掌心传来，那是血脉相连的证明。"小念，"他的声音有些哽咽，"我答应你。"陈念闻言，眼中的金芒渐渐收敛，取而代之的是夺眶而出的泪水。"哥……"她扑进陈机怀中，压抑了多年的情绪在这一刻彻底宣泄。

text.content: The Council Hall was so quiet one could only hear Chen Nian's soft sobs. Those who had once mocked her now低下头，不敢与那双泛红的眼眸对视。Han Lie opened his mouth,想要说些什么，最终却只能黯然退场。他知道，今天的他，彻彻底底地沦为了背景板。Chen Ji轻拍着妹妹的后背，目光却落在手中那两页天机录上。两页残页相互靠近的瞬间，一幅模糊的幻象骤然浮现在他脑海中——崩塌的天穹，破碎的大地，以及一个看不清面容的身影，正站在废墟之上。

dialogue.content: "Little Nian, not yet." Chen Ji gently pressed his sister's shoulder, his gaze alertly scanning the two fragments. "This power came too suddenly; we need to understand its source." He separated the two fragments and stored them in his embrace, yet his fingertips could still sense that warm resonance. Chen Nian raised her head to look at him, a flash of disappointment in her eyes, but it was quickly replaced by understanding. "Brother, I'll follow your lead." She softly said, yet immediately lowered her voice, "But that vision... I saw it too just now."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and made his decision. He released the hand pressing the fragments, allowing that warm power to spread through his palm. "Since this is our fate, let's face it together." The two fragments slowly rotated between Chen Ji and Chen Nian, gradually approaching. When they finally merged as one, a brilliant golden light shot skyward, illuminating the entire Council Hall as bright as day. Within that light, the siblings simultaneously saw that blurry vision—collapsing celestial dome, shattered earth, and that mysterious figure standing atop the ruins.

dialogue.content: "Alright." Chen Ji nodded, a gentle smile curving his lips, but no one noticed the subtle mark his hidden hand secretly formed within his sleeve. The Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace radiated gentle warmth, seemingly responding to his will. "Little Nian, from now on, you are my right-hand man." He solemnly declared, yet a flicker of calculation deep in his eyes remained. No matter how strong his sister became, he would never放下手中的棋—this was an instinct刻在骨子里。

text.content: The vision faded, and the siblings simultaneously snapped back to consciousness from that strange state. Chen Ji's face was pale, clearly that momentary天机预见 had consumed much of his energy. Chen Nian tightly gripped his hand, her fingertips trembling slightly. "Brother, that figure..." Her voice carried a hint of fear, "I feel like I've seen it somewhere before." Chen Ji offered no response, merely shielding his sister behind him, his gaze profound as he stared at the sky beyond the Council Hall. Mo Xiansheng had once said, the more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger fate's mandatory backlash. And now, the two fragments have begun merging—this means an even greater storm approaches.

"Little Nian, you just mentioned that figure seems familiar?" Chen Ji turned around, his gaze sharp as he stared at his sister. Chen Nian nodded, her brow furrowed. "During my time at the Holy Sect, they performed bloodline experiments on me; at that time I entered a strange space, and that figure was inside." She paused, her voice lowering, "And... that figure said one thing to me—'A thread of heavenly secrets, sisters share the same origin.'" Chen Ji's heart tightened; a thread of heavenly secrets, sisters share the same origin—what did this mean? Could there be some deeper connection between the Chen family's bloodline and the Tianji Record?

Suddenly, commotion arose outside the Council Hall. A disciple rushed in, his expression panicked as he reported: "Terrible news! Xuanwu Sect's Han Lie has gathered fellow disciples, saying he wants to report today's events to the Sect Master!" Upon hearing this, Chen Ji curled his lips into a cold smile. So Han Lie, as expected, still couldn't改掉那死性不改，被当众打脸之后居然想要告状。"Let him go." He said calmly, "正好让凌渊掌门看看，他一直拉拢的玄武宗天才，究竟是何等货色。" Chen Nian stood at his side, her gaze firm. "Brother, whatever happens, I'm on your side."

Chen Ji looked at his sister's firm gaze, an indescribable emotion surging in his heart. Over these years, he had walked alone on the blade's edge, treating everyone as chess pieces, never imagining that one day someone would fight shoulder to shoulder with him. Now, his sister's awakening made him understand that Father's testament was not empty words—the Chen family's bloodline truly should not have only one person fighting. "Alright." He softly said, reaching out to rub the top of Chen Nian's head, the gesture carrying a warmth long missed. "Then let us siblings together go see this good show." With that, he turned and strode out of the Council Hall, his silhouette no longer carrying its usual loneliness, gaining instead the composure of fighting alongside a companion.

However, the moment Chen Ji stepped out of the Council Hall's door, the Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace suddenly vibrated violently. An icy chill spread from his chest throughout his entire body, as if some terrifying existence was secretly watching them. Chen Ji's footsteps halted, his face dramatically changing. "Brother?" Chen Nian sensed his abnormality and asked with concern. Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the unease in his heart, and quietly said: "Nothing... I just have a feeling of being watched." He did not speak the后半句话—那种感觉，与天机录中记载的"天道之眼"的描述惊人地相似。
